subject: science
prompt:
## More than a frame

Stand up, bend down and lift a box of books from the floor. The bones of your skeleton are at work the whole time.

**Predict:** Which jobs does your skeleton do while you stand, bend and lift?

options.text: Only one job: it gives the muscles something firm to pull on.
It supports the body, protects delicate organs, and gives muscles firm bones to pull on.
It only protects organs such as the brain and heart, because movement is the job of muscles alone.
